auth.login_body: Roehub uses a Keycloak-backed account flow. No local username or password is collected by this web shell.
auth.logout_body: Ending your Roehub session. You will be redirected after the server confirms logout.
auth.register_body: Create or activate your Roehub account through the same Keycloak-backed identity flow used for login.
auth.register_note: Roehub Web does not store local registration passwords.
landing.audience_developers_body: Build, test, and manage robust strategy code at scale.
landing.audience_researchers_body: Backtest ideas, validate hypotheses, and iterate faster.
landing.audience_teams_body: Collaborate, share, and deploy systematic work with confidence.
landing.audience_traders_body: Automate execution and focus on what matters: your edge.
landing.body: Roehub unifies backtesting, strategy management, and trading automation in one terminal-grade web shell.
landing.capability_backtests_body: Run fast, reliable backtests on scalable infrastructure.
landing.capability_cloud_body: Deploy strategies to cloud runtime based on proven results.
landing.capability_exchanges_body: Connect major exchanges and keep account operations in sync.
landing.capability_online_body: Execute strategies with online controls and risk checks.
landing.capability_paper_body: Test strategies in a risk-free environment before going live.
landing.capability_portfolio_body: Organize, version, and manage multiple strategies in one place.
landing.final_body: Join traders who trust Roehub to power their systematic edge.
landing.final_title: Ready to build, test, and automate with confidence?
landing.title: Roehub: research, validate, automate, execute.
